question: Which heart failure patients are not on all four GDMT pillars?
definition: Heart failure = any I50.* diagnosis on a condition record, an encounter diagnosis (EHR or ADT) or a payer claim; alive at as_of (no CCLF8 death date on or before as_of). Pillars: (1) evidence-based HF beta blocker (carvedilol, metoprolol succinate, bisoprolol); (2) ACE inhibitor, ARB or sacubitril/valsartan; (3) MRA (spironolactone, eplerenone); (4) SGLT2 inhibitor. On a pillar = active on the medication list, or a fill whose supply covers any of the 120 days before as_of. List patients missing one or more pillars.

question: Which patients went to the ED with low back pain, were discharged home, and had no physical therapy within 60 days?
definition: ED visit = payer claim with place of service 23, revenue code 045x or CPT 99281-99285, service date in the 12 months before as_of and at least 60 days before as_of, with M54.5* on the claim. Discharged home = no inpatient admission (TOB 011x/012x or ADT inpatient) starting that day or the next. PT = CPT 97161-97164, 97110, 97112, 97140, 97530 on any claim line with service in the 60 days after the visit.

question: Which diabetic patients have an A1c above 9 with no visit after it?
definition: Diabetes = E10*/E11* on a condition record, an encounter diagnosis or a payer claim. The latest A1c dated 30 to 365 days before as_of is above 9.0%, and there is no visit (completed office-class encounter (office, wellness or pediatric; virtual and telephone excluded), or billed CPT 99202-99215) on days 1-30 after it. Lab-draw, nurse-only, telephone and orders-only contacts do not count as follow-up.

question: Which patients had 4 or more ED visits in the last 12 months?
definition: ED visits = distinct dates with an ED payer claim (place of service 23, revenue code 045x or CPT 99281-99285) or an EHR emergency encounter, in the 12 months before as_of.

question: Which patients discharged from the hospital had no follow-up visit within 14 days?
definition: Inpatient discharges (TOB 011x/012x with discharge status 01 or 06, or ADT inpatient with disposition home or home health) 14 to 182 days before as_of, with no visit (completed office-class encounter (office, wellness or pediatric; virtual and telephone excluded), or billed CPT 99202-99215) on days 1-14 after discharge. Lab-draw, nurse-only, telephone and orders-only contacts do not count as follow-up.

question: Which diabetic patients aged 40 to 75 are not on a statin?
definition: Diabetes = E10*/E11* on a condition record or payer claim; age 40-75 at as_of; alive at as_of. Not on a statin = no active statin on the medication list and no statin fill covering any of the 120 days before as_of.

question: Which patients with a PHQ-9 of 10 or more had no follow-up within 30 days?
definition: PHQ-9 total >= 10 dated 30 to 365 days before as_of, with no visit (completed office-class encounter (office, wellness or pediatric; virtual and telephone excluded), or billed CPT 99202-99215) and no behavioral health claim (CPT 90791, 90792, 90832-90838, 90846, 90847, 90853) on days 1-30 after it. Lab-draw, nurse-only, telephone and orders-only contacts do not count as follow-up.

question: Which women are overdue for breast cancer screening?
definition: Women aged 52-74 at as_of, alive, with an enrollment span covering as_of, and no mammogram (cancer screening record or CPT 77065-77067, G0202, G0204, G0206) in the 27 months before as_of.

question: Which patients have statin adherence below 80% last year?
definition: Patients with 2 or more statin fills in the calendar year before as_of. PDC = days covered from the first fill in that year through 12-31, divided by those days; overlaps are not shifted; supply from earlier fills counts for days it covers. List patients with PDC below 80%.
